votes.motion: Approve the Work Session Minutes of February 13, 2024
votes.description: The Council approved the official work session meeting minutes from February 13, 2024.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items B-1 through B-3 to a future Consent Agenda for action
votes.description: Closed the public hearing on three EPA Climate Pollution Reduction Grant applications (clean electricity, combined heat and power, and fleet electrification/trees) and referred them to a future consent agenda for action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Zoning Map Amendments at approximately 2760, 2800, and 2828 North 2200 West)
votes.description: Closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone from AG-2 to M-1 for approximately 14.33 acres in Council District 1 and deferred action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Rezone and Master Plan Amendment at approximately 1791 South and 1815 South State Street and 118 East and 120 East Coatsville Avenue)
votes.description: Closed the public hearing on a proposed rezone from CC and R-1/5000 to R-MU for properties in Council District 5 and deferred action to a future meeting; Council Member Mano recused himself.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Window Requirements for New Construction in The City's Local Historic Districts)
votes.description: Closed the public hearing on a proposed ordinance amending Title 21A regarding window materials and installation standards for new construction in historic districts and landmark sites, and deferred action.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing to a future Council meeting (Citywide Transportation Plan: Connect SLC)
votes.description: Continued the public hearing on the 2023 Citywide Transportation Plan (Connect SLC) to allow additional time for review and briefing before taking action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 22 of 2024, requiring the demolition notice to be posted at the location
votes.description: Adopted an ordinance amending Title 21A to add enforcement tools for work done without a Certificate of Appropriateness in the H Historic Preservation Overlay, including a requirement to post demolition notices on-site.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 12 of 2024 for FY2024-25 HUD grant programs: CDBG, ESG, HOME, HOPWA, HOME-ARPA, and CDBG-CV
votes.description: Approved the One-Year Annual Action Plan and authorized federal grant funding allocations for fiscal year 2024-25 including CDBG, HOME, ESG, HOPWA, and related programs, and approved an Interlocal Agreement with HUD.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 28 of 2024, authorizing the full single upfront payment of $1.612 million from the General Fund Balance for item A-10: Downtown Parking Pay Station Replacements
votes.description: Completed the partial adoption of Budget Amendment No. 3 for FY2023-24 by approving a one-time $1.612 million General Fund payment for downtown parking pay station replacements.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 23 of 2024 (Temporary Zoning Regulation – Volunteers of America Youth Resource Center)
votes.description: Enacted a temporary zoning regulation allowing the Volunteers of America Youth Resource Center at 888 South 400 West to increase maximum capacity up to 50 individuals for up to 180 days.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 24 of 2024 (Temporary Zoning Regulation – Geraldine E. King Women's Resource Center)
votes.description: Extended a temporary zoning regulation allowing the Geraldine E. King Women's Resource Center at 131 East 700 South to increase maximum capacity up to 250 individuals, effective May 1, 2024 for up to 180 days.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 25 of 2024 (Temporary Zoning Regulation – Gail Miller Resource Center)
votes.description: Extended a temporary zoning regulation allowing the Gail Miller Resource Center at 242 West Paramount Avenue to increase maximum capacity up to 250 individuals, effective May 1, 2024 for up to 180 days.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 27 of 2024 (Temporary Zoning Regulation – St. Vincent de Paul Center)
votes.description: Extended a temporary zoning regulation allowing the St. Vincent de Paul Center at 437 West 200 South to provide overnight homeless shelter beyond April 15 at current occupancy levels, effective May 1, 2024 for up to 180 days.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 26 of 2024 (Temporary Zoning Regulation – MicroShelter Community Program)
votes.description: Extended a temporary zoning regulation authorizing the temporary shelter community at approximately 255 South 600 West to continue operations from June 1, 2024 through July 31, 2024.

Approved all items on the consent agenda, including setting public hearing dates for zoning amendments and budget items, and approving the board appointment of Isaac Atencio to the Business Advisory Board.
